query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T00:00:00Z"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           host.name,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.name
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
